subject: Urban Planning
title: Vienna's Social Housing: A Century of Success
description: A micro-lesson that makes Vienna's Social Housing: A Century of Success usable.

hook.text: 62% of Vienna's residents live in subsidized housing. They love it. There's no stigma at all.

buildup.text: After World War I, Vienna taxed luxury goods to fund massive public housing blocks called Gemeindebauten.

discovery.text: These weren't grim towers. They had courtyards, gardens, kindergartens, and libraries inside the complexes.

twist.text: Because everyone lives in social housing — rich and poor — it's maintained well and carries no shame.

climax.text: Vienna is consistently ranked the world's most livable city. Housing policy is why.

punchline.text: When public housing is for everyone, everyone benefits.

quiz.question: What percentage of Vienna's residents live in subsidized housing?
